subject: Trial runway extension + credit-swap proposal
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@haloai.com>, procurement@haloai.com
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial runway extension and credit-swap proposal

Hi Samantha / Halo procurement team,

Thanks again for the thorough feedback after last week's demo. We saw the increased query volume in the POC logs (attached) and appreciate the runway you gave the team. To avoid interrupting signal for your engineering sprint next week, I want to propose a short extension and an optional usage-credit structure that aligns to your needs while keeping the commercial terms simple.

Proposal (two options) — happy to pick one that works for you:

- Option A (credit-swap, minimal paperwork): 3-week extension to the time-boxed trial; Redwood provides an $8,000 usage credit that will be applied as a billing credit if you convert to a paid contract within 60 days after the POC end date. No change to per-token pricing.
- Option B (shorter extension, reduced admin): 2-week extension + a flat 10% discount on the next month of committed capacity if you sign a 6-month Dedicated commitment within 45 days.

Attachments: Halo_POC_usage_summary.xlsx (usage + latency), Redwood_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf (clean addendum we can sign).

If procurement prefers, we can do a lightweight addendum (1 page) that DocuSigns quickly. If that would help speed approval, I can loop legal and ship a draft today.

Next steps: which option do you prefer? If we get a thumbs-up by COB tomorrow we can lock the trial dates and send the addendum.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@haloai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial runway extension and credit-swap proposal

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear options and for sending the usage summary. Quick clarifying questions from procurement/ops side:

- The credit in Option A — is that refundable if we don't sign? (Procurement prefers credits that apply to future invoices rather than retro refunds.)
- For Option B, does the 6-month commitment have a minimum capacity or $ floor we should be aware of?
- We have an internal freeze on any addendum that increases liability; can you confirm there are no penalty clauses tied to the credit?

We prefer the 3-week extension operationally, but need the contractual mechanics spelled out so our procurement team can greenlight. If you can provide a one-page addendum that shows the credit as an invoice credit application (not cash refund) and a simple acceptance workflow, we can fast-track review.

— Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Engineering, Halo AI
samantha@haloai.com

Markus / Ben — forwarding Halo's procurement follow-ups (below). They like the operational extension but need the credit mechanics clarified as an invoice credit and confirmation there are no penalty clauses.

My suggested response / ask:
- Approve Option A (3-week extension + $8k usage credit applied as invoice credit) provided we clearly state: credit is applied to future invoices (not refunded), expires 90 days after POC end, and is only usable if they convert to a paid contract.
- We do NOT change per-token pricing or commit to any SLAs beyond standard POC support.
- Redwood signs a 1-page addendum that mirrors language below; we use the existing Term Sheet as reference.

Suggested addendum language (short form we can hand to legal):
- Trial extension: POC end date extended by 21 days from original end date.
- Usage credit: Redwood will apply an $8,000 invoice credit to the first paid invoice submitted by Halo AI if a paid order is executed within 90 days of the extended POC end date. Unused credit expires 90 days after the POC end date and is non-transferable.
- No other financial penalties or liabilities are created by this addendum.

Can you confirm we can offer this as a quick addendum? If approved, I will draft the DocuSign and include HubSpot deal HALO-2026-01 in the file.

Thanks — Naomi

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial runway extension and credit-swap proposal — Halo procurement questions

Naomi — approved with one condition: the credit must be conditioned on execution of a paid order (as you wrote), and acceptance of the addendum must not create any auto-renewal obligations or extended liability. Legal should include a single sentence stating this explicitly.

Ben — please prepare the one-page addendum using Naomi's bullets and attach the Redwood_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf as the reference exhibit. Also cc Naomi and Samantha when you send to DocuSign. Aim to have draft to Naomi by EOD tomorrow so we can move quickly.
